text:
casey_sales: Emerald Systems CTO pushed back — POC blocked unless we can guarantee 99.9% uptime for 30 days, EU-only, and a hard pricing cap of $5,000/mo. They also want dedicated tenancy + SOC2 evidence. Asking for an exec touchpoint today. Can we mobilize a short-term plan?

katie_salesops: What's the source for the $5k cap? Our current quote is $8k/mo. Also need region/throughput details.

casey_sales: They emailed: $5k is firm for the pilot. Region: eu-west-1. Expected throughput ~60 reqs/min, avg seq len 512. No shared tenancy allowed per CTO.

lin_sre: 99.9% for a POC is aggressive. For Dedicated we can meet that with reserved capacity + failover, but needs ops carve-out. What logging/retention do they expect? @derek_eng can you check capacity in eu-west-1?

maria_ciso: They also requested KMS/customer-managed keys and SOC2 Type II attestation. We'll need to provide the cert and a short KMS security note for their CISO. Legal review likely required if CMK requested.

derek_eng: We have limited Dedicated pool in eu-west-1. We can carve out a 4-GPU pod for 30 days but require a signed short-term commitment (MSA addendum). Alternative: Hosted regional setup with cross-region failover + best-effort SLA, but that won't meet 99.9%. For CMK we can support BYOK but need legal & infra signoff.

sam_engineer: Technical option: offer a quantized model variant to reduce memory/cost by ~35% — could fit a 2-GPU config. If pricing cap is non-negotiable, propose a 2-week reduced-capacity trial with auto-fallback to a lower-cost model. Also can deliver a small failover demo for exec call.

alex_finance: If we give a one-time promo to hit $5k, we need FP approval. What's the ARR upside? Please flag potential long-term deal size. Quote id for reference: Q-4310-EMERALD-01.

deploy-bot: Quote Q-4310-EMERALD-01 generated by katie_salesops. Link: https://redwood.co/quotes/Q-4310-EMERALD-01

casey_sales: @derek_eng can you confirm carve-out feasibility by EOD? Emerald asked for an exec call at 16:00 CET. Can someone from execs join (legal/ops/finance)?

derek_eng: I can confirm by EOD conditional on Legal signing the addendum. Ops needs ~48h lead time to provision the pod and run security hardening.

katie_salesops: I'll ping Legal and Finance for a fast-track review and draft an MSA addendum. Booking the 16:00 CET slot tentatively.

sam_engineer: If we need a demo script for the exec call, here's a quick one-liner to exercise the endpoint:```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://eu.poc.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}'
```I can run a failover demonstration showing request continuity across two pods.

alex_finance: Noted. I need an ARR estimate to justify the promo. Casey, can you share expected expansion or contract value post-POC?

casey_sales: They're projecting $120k ARR if POC succeeds. I'll confirm in the thread. Priority actions: 1) Confirm Dedicated carve-out or fallback plan (derek) 2) Legal to draft addendum (katie) 3) Finance quick review on promo (alex) 4) Security to prepare SOC2 cert & KMS note (maria) 5) Eng to prep demo/failover script (sam). Thanks all — I’ll update once Legal responds. :thumbsup:
